name: FileFlows
description:
Save storage space with efficient file processing.

FileFlows lets you monitor and process any file type with custom flows. Videos, audio, images, archives, comics, eBooks—you name it!

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  fileflows:
    container_name: fileflows
    devices:
      - /dev/dri:/dev/dri
    environment:
      PGID: $PGID
      PUID: $PUID
      TZ: $TZ
    hostname: fileflows
    image: revenz/fileflows:stable
    labels:
      icon: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/IceWhaleTech/CasaOS-AppStore@main/Apps/FileFlows/icon.svg
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - target: 5000
        published: "${APP_PORT}"
        protocol: tcp
    network_mode: bridge
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/data
        target: /app/Data
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/logs
        target: /app/Logs
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/common
        target: /app/common
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/temp
        target: /temp
      - type: bind
        source: ${SHARED_DIR}/Media
        target: /Media
      - type: bind
        source: /var/run/docker.sock
        target: /var/run/docker.sock
